test_SqlDatasetReader: test the SqlDatasetReader class to load a HuggingFace Dataset from a SQLite database
test_SqlDatasetWriter: test the SqlDatasetWriter class to write a HuggingFace Dataset to a SQLite database
create_SqlDatasetReader_keep_in_memory: create a SqlDatasetReader that loads data from SQLite with keep_in_memory option enabled or disabled
create_SqlDatasetReader_features: create a SqlDatasetReader with explicit Features and Value dtype specifications for each column
test_SqlDatasetWriter_multiproc: test the SqlDatasetWriter with multiple processes to write dataset rows to SQLite concurrently
